intent: Preserve classic speech runtime and independent Jev cached testing; add a switchable Doubao full-duplex route, safe microphone ownership and local enrollment handoff.

evidence: device/lira/audio/doubao_realtime.py:238-240: await self._stop_output(); await self.player.close(); if self.ws is not None:
device/lira/audio/doubao_realtime.py:231-233: if self.closed: return; self.closed = True (cleanup cannot subsequently be retried).

findings.suggested_fix: Run audio stop/player close and WebSocket close/queue erasure in nested try/finally blocks so every cleanup stage runs even if the sound device fails; propagate the original audio error after cleanup. Add a fake-player stop failure regression asserting socket closure and sensitive buffer clearing.
findings.title: Audio stop failure prevents cloud session cleanup
findings.why_it_matters: When the board output device fails while stopping, close exits before closing the WebSocket or clearing queued microphone data and tool results. ConversationPaths._stop has already removed the session reference, and closed=True suppresses later cleanup attempts, leaving the cloud connection unclosed and aborting route switching/privacy/shutdown cleanup.
